RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Back to basics
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 12% global work speed, research speed, mining yield and plant harvest yield per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Overload
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 65% actual power output per stack to player generators using standard power-generation components. Unfueled, switched-off or broken generators still produce no power. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Money makes money
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each day earns 0.325% × stacks interest on unforbidden, revealed silver on player home maps. Interest is calculated before other daily income. Combined with Paid work, daily income is capped at 20,000 silver. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Paid work
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each free colonist produces 15 × stacks silver per day. Combined with Money makes money, daily income is capped at 20,000 silver. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Storage ring
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: All colonists gain 120% carrying capacity per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Bloodthirster
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: All colonists gain 9.1% direct-damage lifesteal against enemies per stack, healing ordinary injuries only. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Unexpected arrival
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each selection recruits one additional colonist near an existing colonist on a player home map. Recruits are queued if no receiving map is available.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Genesis
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each selection grants 45 packaged survival meals. Each stack adds 0.455 to the food-poisoning chance divisor and 22.75% plant harvest yield. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Slow simmer
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: All colonists gain 40% plant harvest yield per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Stone cellar harvest
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Whenever a player colonist finishes mining a mineable rock or ore block, grants 1.3 × stacks packaged survival meals, delivered in batches near a colonist. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Earth awakening
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 50% mining speed and 12% global work speed per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Deep veins
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 40% mining yield per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: War foundry
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 45.5% general labor speed, 22.75% global work speed and 9.1% damage against enemies per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Steady production
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 20% construction speed, general labor speed and global work speed per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Mad scientist
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each stack contributes 360 points to the current research project daily. Choosing this card also grants 16% of the current project's progress. If no project is selected, percentage rewards are queued; daily research points are not. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Empirical inquiry
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Grants +13.65% research speed. Drafting stores research progress equal to 16% of the active project cost. Without an unfinished project, the stored progress waits for later use. Draft limit: 8 stacks; older excess stacks are preserved.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Mind over matter
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each day grants all free colonists 130 × stacks base experience in every enabled skill. The game then applies normal learning modifiers. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Crash course
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each day grants all free colonists 1,000 × stacks base experience in both Shooting and Melee. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Dice addict
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each selection immediately grants another random eligible colony card and permanently adds 1 reroll to future drafts. The reward excludes further random-card rewards, Take them all and disabled cards.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Take them all
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Also grants the other two colony cards in the current draft. Permanently reduces future rerolls by 1, to a minimum of 0. Each of the three cards is resolved once and can trigger its selection rewards.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Vault surge
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each selection immediately grants 1,500 × (1 + full game years elapsed) silver, capped at 1,000,000 per selection. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Apprentice rations
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: All colonists gain 70% learning speed per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Glass cannon
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: All colonists gain 91% direct damage against enemies per stack. Damage taken multiplier increases by 25% per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Golden spatula
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: All colonists gain 45.5% construction speed, 45.5% plant work speed and 11.375% movement speed per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Universal scope
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 3.25 cells of effective ranged attack range to all colonists per stack. Applies to attacks using the game's standard range calculation. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Tailwind
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: All colonists gain 12% movement speed per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: United resolve
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: All colonists' mental break thresholds are reduced by 0.02275 per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Campaign trail
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Reduces mental break threshold by 0.01365 and adds 0.2275 to the recreation drain divisor per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Carnival core
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each day restores 26% recreation per stack to every free colonist, up to full. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Silk road
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 6.825% trade price improvement and delivers 97 silver daily per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Golden bargaining
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 0.11375 trade price improvement and 22.75% negotiation ability per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Unhindered march
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: While drafted, ignore 65% of movement delay from passable terrain; additional stacks add nothing. Doors, walls and obstacles retain their rules.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Goliath
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 100% health, 30% damage against enemies and 0.25 to the damage-taken divisor per stack. Does not change body size. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Deft
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 0.5 to melee and ranged attack cooldown divisors per stack. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Mighty
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 40% direct damage against enemies per stack. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Critical edge
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 40% critical rating per stack. Rating above 100% further increases critical damage. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Recursion
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each stack grants 65% item haste and 65% ability haste. Existing item benefits are retained. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: All-purpose scope
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 7.8 cells of effective ranged range and 13.65% shooting accuracy per stack, capped at 100% accuracy. Cover and weapon accuracy are still calculated separately. Applies to attacks using standard range calculation. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Heavy hitter
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each valid direct attack deals an additional 3.25 × stacks × the wearer's total health scale damage. The scale includes racial health and augment bonuses. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Stackosaurus
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each stack increases newly gained Heartsteel, feast, soul marks, Overlord kills and Phenomenal evil growth by 65%. Existing growth is not doubled retroactively. Does not increase card selection stacks. Draft limit: 6 stacks. Each permanent growth effect retains its full benefit through 100 points, then has diminishing returns.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Tap dancer
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each valid hit gains a dance step. Each step adds 5.2% × card stacks movement speed and the same amount to melee and ranged cooldown divisors. Steps are lost after 10 seconds without a hit. Draft limit: 6 stacks. The first 20 temporary stacks retain their full effect; further stacks have diminishing returns.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Phenomenal Evil
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Effective ability or secondary damage grants 0.65 permanent evil growth per card stack, once per 10 ticks. Each point adds 3% ability and secondary damage. Fractional growth is retained. Each permanent growth effect retains its full benefit through 100 points, then has diminishing returns.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Magic Missile
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Every third direct hit fires three missiles. The first effective ability hit on each enemy per cast also fires three. Each missile deals (5.2 + 1.95 × target health scale) secondary damage per stack. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Infernal Conduit
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Direct hits apply stacking burn. Burning refunds item and ability cooldowns at most once per second: 0.325 seconds per card stack, up to 10 seconds per trigger. Ethereal Weapon also lets abilities apply this burn. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Fan the flames
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Valid hits add 2.6 × stacks damage per second to the target's burn and refresh it to six pulses. Accumulates in the same attacker's burn as Infernal conduit. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Vulnerability
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 18.2% critical rating per stack. Allows RimHex burns, bleeding, missiles and other additional damage to critically strike. Each additional-damage instance rolls once and does not advance chain-hit counters. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Critical Healing
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each stack adds 18.2% critical value. Healing and shields can critically strike using the holder's critical value. The bonus critical healing multiplier is 65% at one stack, capped at 100% with multiple stacks; excess critical value also benefits from this factor.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Lightkeeper
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: While standing, about every 12.5 seconds grants a 22.75 × stacks shield to up to 12 friendly colonists within 10 cells, including the wearer. Lasts 12.5 seconds. Refreshes retain the stronger shield. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Courage of the colossus
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Successfully stunning an enemy grants a shield of 26 × stacks × (1 + RimHex health bonus), lasting 5 seconds. Control benefits trigger at most once per second. Everfrost can trigger this effect. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Cruel amusement
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Successfully stunning an enemy heals the wearer for 16.25 × stacks ordinary injury points. Shares the once-per-second trigger interval with other control benefits. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Ocean soul
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each valid hit heals the wearer for 5.2 × stacks ordinary injury points. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Mountain soul
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: After 5 seconds without being attacked, refreshes a 26 × stacks shield about every 4.2 seconds, lasting about 8.3 seconds. Keeps the stronger capacity. Being attacked stops refreshes until the waiting condition is met again. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Infernal soul
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Valid hits create a blast within 3.5 cells of the target, dealing 11.7 × stacks armor-piercing damage to up to 12 standing enemies. At most once every 2 seconds. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Homeguard
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: After 5 seconds without being attacked, gains 68.25% × stacks movement speed. Being attacked removes the bonus until another five seconds pass. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Restless recovery
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: While moving, heals 12 × stacks ordinary injury points about every 4.2 seconds. Stops when stationary. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Perseverance
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: About every 4.2 seconds, heals 9.6 ordinary injury points per card stack, increased to 40 below 50% overall health. Can heal living downed colonists. Draft limit: 6 stacks; older excess stacks are preserved.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Apex inventor
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each stack grants 195 item haste. Applicable item cooldowns are divided by 1 + haste/100. Ascension rerolls per day are unchanged. Draft limit: 6 stacks; older excess stacks are preserved.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Shrink ray
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Valid hits divide the enemy's damage by (1 + 0.65 × stacks) for 5 seconds. Further hits refresh the duration; stronger sources take priority. Does not change body size. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Symphony of war
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each valid hit gains a symphony stack. Each adds 3.9% × card stacks direct damage and 0.078 × card stacks to the attack cooldown divisor. Lost after 10 seconds without a hit. Draft limit: 6 stacks. The first 20 temporary stacks retain their full effect; further stacks have diminishing returns.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Stats!
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Immediately gains two random attribute bonuses. Each grants 39% damage, 39% health, 39% movement speed or +0.39 attack cooldown divisor. Results are permanent and can repeat. In the random-stat pool, damage and health bonuses taper above 200%; move and attack speed bonuses taper above 100%. Stored gains are preserved.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: More stats!
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Immediately gains three random attribute bonuses. Each grants 39% damage, 39% health, 39% movement speed or +0.39 attack cooldown divisor. Results are permanent and can repeat. In the random-stat pool, damage and health bonuses taper above 200%; move and attack speed bonuses taper above 100%. Stored gains are preserved.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Even more stats!
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Immediately gains four random attribute bonuses. Each grants 39% damage, 39% health, 39% movement speed or +0.39 attack cooldown divisor. Results are permanent and can repeat. In the random-stat pool, damage and health bonuses taper above 200%; move and attack speed bonuses taper above 100%. Stored gains are preserved.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Prismatic transformation
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Immediately grants one random eligible prismatic personal card. Excludes disabled, capped and further random-card rewards. Existing augments are retained.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Master of Duality
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Direct hits build spell power; ability and secondary damage build attack power. Each temporary stack adds 3.9% ability/secondary damage or direct damage per card stack respectively. Secondary growth is limited to once per 10 ticks; bonuses lapse after 10 seconds without a direct hit. Draft limit: 6 stacks. The first 20 temporary stacks retain their full effect; further stacks have diminishing returns.
